evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies transaction download orphan resolution logic in MempoolRejectedTx.
rationale: Prevents orphan transactions from getting stuck when a non-witness parent is rejected with TX_RECONSIDERABLE. Because a non-witness transaction's txid equals its wtxid, 'MempoolRejectedTx to wipe queued txid requests intended to resolve orphan children' causes the orphan resolution requests to prematurely drop and orphan children to fail to resolve.
